'''Rodin Baem''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|man]], who worked as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Rodin Baem worked with Imperial covert operations teams as an informant and contact. He gained the confidence of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and assisted Vader in locating several bases that were used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Following the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Baem continued to serve the Empire and supplied information for various Imperials, including [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gaen Drommel]] and [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Par Lankin]].<ref name="WBC" /> By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="WC Dates" /> the New Republic had placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 40,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] on Baem.<ref name="WBC" />
